finding.headline: "The Boot-Test Fail"
finding.problem: "I spent ₦150k on a pram I saw on Instagram. It doesn't close small enough for my car. I can't return it. My baby isn't even born and I've already wasted money I don't have."
finding.person: Lagos mum who bought a bulky travel-system pram online, discovered it won't fit her Toyota Corolla boot, now stuck with a white-elephant.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (stroller-buying decision tree) inside A4.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
